name: api-status-health-banner
title: API Status Health Banner
description: A real-time edge system status banner reporting uptime percentages, latency metrics, and recent incident logs.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Api Status Health Banner Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
